topics.title: Happy new year
topics.summary: Today on the Stern Show, Howard welcomes the staff back from the holiday break, and hears about what everyone did. Plus, Robin and Jim Florentine spent New Years together, Howard skips Jon Hein’s daughter’s bat mitzvah, and Richard is denied ‘Elf Service.’

topics.title: Sals dream come true
topics.summary: Today on the Stern Show, a look at Artie’s scandalous weekend at the AVN awards. Plus, Eric the Midget requests a new name, Howard goes to dinner with his parents, and Gary’s got some new clothes (and teeth).

topics.title: Got spade
topics.summary: Today on the Stern Show, Don King stops by to talk boxing and reflect on the greats. Plus, Gilbert Gottfried visits the studio as a new father!

topics.title: Sunny disses booey
topics.summary: Today on the Stern Show, roast master Jeff Ross appears in studio to discuss his past burns, and turns his attention to the staff. Plus, Eric the Midget calls in with his girlfriend, and a couple Sybian riders can’t finish with Gary present.

topics.title: A sybian pro
topics.summary: Today on the Stern Show, porn star Victoria Zdrok comes into the studio to dispense some love advice and ride the Sybian like a pro. Plus, J.J. Abrams and Sylvester Stallone both call in!

topics.title: Beat the foot for boobs
topics.summary: Today on the Stern Show, a woman named Michelle plays Beat the Foot against Bigfoot. The stakes: a new pair of breast implants. Plus, Vinny Favale calls in, Sal cries, and Howard investigates Dave Letterman’s chair settings.
